newsitem.title: POLAND: Rolimpex to buy 33 pct of feed firm.
newsitem.headline: Rolimpex to buy 33 pct of feed firm.

text.p: Polish food trader and producer Rolimpex SA signed a preliminary agreement with National Investment Fund (NFI) No 1 to buy the NFI's 33-percent stake in feed firm Dolpasz SA, Rolimpex said in a statement on Tuesday.
Dolpasz is Poland's largest feed producer, making a net profit of 0.5 million zlotys in the first three months of this year on sales of 41.5 million zlotys.
NFI 1 said in its prospectus earlier this year that Dolpasz's share in the feed grain market ranged from five to seven percent. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
